content_sections.heading: About TMC Senior Assistant Data Manager Recruitment
content_sections.text: This recruitment is conducted by the Tata Memorial Centre, Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) located in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai (Phone No : +91-22-68735000/5082/5353, www.actrec.gov.in), which is a Grant-in-aid Institution of the Dept. of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The positions are specifically created for the project titled “NTPC Limited” under the Centre for Cancer Epidemiology (CCE) Building. The appointments are made on a temporary project basis.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Mandatory educational qualification and experience criteria (Candidates must satisfy 1 OR 2): Option 1: Post Graduate in relevant field + Minimum six-month computer course from recognized institute or MS-CIT Certificate. After completing Post Graduation minimum Three year’s experience in relevant field is mandatory. Option 2: Graduate in relevant field + Minimum six-month computer course from recognized institute or MS-CIT Certificate. After completing Post Graduation minimum Five year’s experience in relevant field is mandatory. Note: Period of Training, Obervership, Internship etc., will not be considered as work experience.
